note: Single-probe capture for issue #97: the exact { NULL: false } PutItem rejection message in every region the sweep observes (registry/regions.json). The rejection is request-level validation thrown before table resolution - verified in eu-west-2, where a nonexistent table name returns the same message - so the probe fires one PutItem per region against a nonexistent _conformance_ table name and creates no tables. Two message forms, differing only by the leading 1-validation-error-detected envelope: six regions prefixed, twenty-seven bare, me-south-1 unreachable (issue #93).
